summary_1line: Vidura summons sage Sanat-sujata, who teaches Dhritarashtra that ignorance and desire are true death while knowledge and self-restraint bring immortality.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Sanat-sujata suddenly appears before Dhritarashtra and Vidura after being silently summoned in thought.
Sanat-sujata teaches the blind king in a quiet chamber while Vidura stands respectfully beside the radiant ascetic.
A symbolic vision of men stumbling like drunkards toward dark pits, driven by desire while a calm sage stands untouched by death.
